$comment: Layer 1 runtime manifest — EXAMPLE, not loaded by the build. In production this JSON is the payload of a Nuxeo document (default `note:note` on the document named by `manifestDocumentPath`), NOT a file in the bundle. That is deliberate: a Nuxeo document inherits the repository's versioning, audit trail and ACLs, and it survives a marketplace upgrade. To try it, create the document and paste this in.
$labels: Overrides for i18n keys, layered on by the translate loader.
$extensions: Everything addressable. Slot names and IDs come from docs/extension-reference.md.

extensions.$overrides: Change a registered descriptor without restating it. Keyed by ID.

overrides.$comment_hide: Hide the template's Reports entry entirely.
overrides.$comment_relabel: Relabel and move Home without touching code.

extensions.$slots: Add entries a manifest owns. These merge with what code registered; they do not replace it.

slots.$comment_drawer: Place the component registered under `template.sidebar.reports` into a drawer. The ID is the contract — the manifest never names a class.
slots.$comment_action: Place the registered handler `template.actions.exportSummary` on the toolbar, gated by a rule the template registered.
